WHAT: K3s (lightweight Kubernetes) running on Ned's VPS (8 cores, 32GB RAM, 8GB). New projects get a namespace + domain automatically on push.

WHY: Solved the Vinted deployment problem — instead of manual deploy per project, everything goes through K3s. One VPS hosts all products.

HOW: Push code → K3s picks it up → maps to domain. No manual server config per project.

IMPLICATIONS:
- Vinted Fashion Finder: ready to deploy (no more 'deploy problem' blocking it)
- HTML Slides Hosting idea: instant to ship
- Any future small products: zero infra friction
- Multiple products all on one VPS, cost-efficient

STATUS: Running as of March 2026. Ned mentioned it while planning Vinted deployment.
